# TEVM

> In-memory Ethereum Virtual Machine and full node for TypeScript, powered by native Zig (ZEVM) and Viem. Built publicly on Smithers Cloud.

- Public Coding Factory: https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm
- Authenticated MCP Endpoint: https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/mcp
- Shared Build Object Store: https://build.smithers.sh
- GitHub Mirror: https://github.com/evmts/tevm

## Engineering Wiki and Mythical History

- [Start here](https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/blob/main/.smithers/wiki/pages/start-here.md): Navigate TEVM's packages, native ZEVM core, and public Smithers Cloud coding factory.
- [TEVM layered architecture](https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/blob/main/.smithers/wiki/pages/architecture.md): Trace requests from the tevm facade through memory-client, actions, node, and native ZEVM.
- [Native ZEVM engine and Smithers dogfooding](https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/blob/main/.smithers/wiki/pages/zevm-native-engine.md): Explain how Smithers builds, pins, stamps, and caches native ZEVM, Voltaire, and Guillotine Mini.
- [JSON-RPC wire contract and error model](https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/blob/main/.smithers/wiki/pages/json-rpc-contract.md): Specify canonical hex encoding, negative error codes, BaseError hierarchy, and regression proof.
- [Smithers Cloud coding factory and trust boundary](https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/blob/main/.smithers/wiki/pages/coding-factory.md): Document QuickJS-planned flows, shared Smithers Cloud object store cache, and trusted vs untrusted execution.
- [Public authenticated MCP and one-time sandbox auth](https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/blob/main/.smithers/wiki/pages/mcp-and-byoa.md): Show how agents connect via OAuth 2.1 to smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/mcp and mint single-use sandbox tokens.
- [Lighthouse-style backpressure and Uphill audit](https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/blob/main/.smithers/wiki/pages/backpressure-and-uphill.md): Detail TEVM's continuous Uphill metrics across Footprint, Quality, Architecture, and Factory Health.
- [Automated release, GitHub mirror, and docs publishing](https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/blob/main/.smithers/wiki/pages/release-and-docs-pipeline.md): Trace how merges from Smithers Cloud to GitHub main trigger Changesets releases, docs, and llms.txt.
- [Mythical History](https://smithers.sh/evmts/tevm/blob/main/.smithers/history/MYTHICAL.md): Clean from-scratch epic timeline of TEVM.
